purpose: Research-only cross-platform usage calibration. Not approved benchmark measurements and not imported into the application dataset.
explicitExclusions: The incomplete local GLM run was excluded; no local GLM result or usage data is included.
calculationAudit: Corrected costCalibration.anthropicOpusFamilyPair.ratio to the full-precision quotient 11.837583271396396 / 10.79 = 1.097088347673438. The Opus 5.5 scenario already used the raw source costs, so its derived $14.306032053661632 value is unchanged.

notes: Datacurve mean output tokens and mean USD cost are direct source metrics for its own mini-swe-agent configurations where present.
AA per-task costs/tokens are pooled over three benchmarks and are not DeepSWE-only.
Effort labels and reported model strings are retained literally; no model-version aliases are asserted.

sources.denominator: The feed defines efficiency aggregates over scored rollout attempts; individual rows report scored-attempt counts and four runs.
sources.priceBasisNote: Mean cost fields are retained as reported. The source's cost_basis is absent on most rows; absence is not evidence of a common/current price basis.

methodNotes: Each benchmark score averages pass@1 across three attempts per task.
Cost, token usage, and execution time are pooled per-task-attempt averages across the public suite; no per-benchmark efficiency allocation is published.
AA cost is pay-per-token API cost; token usage covers input, cache, cache-write, reasoning, and output categories. Missing telemetry is excluded, not set to zero.

notEstimated: The incomplete local GLM run was excluded and was not used as a calibration point.
Fireworks' DeepSWE-labeled costs are retained only as exact-row source-reported cost scenarios; they remain excluded from calibration and provide no output-token usage.
No DeepSWE output-token projection from AA Coding Agent total-token counts: those totals combine input, cache, cache-write, reasoning, and output and have no per-benchmark split.
No cost derived from output tokens or score; exact input/cache/output mix and per-target price basis are not available for the target benchmark.

The remaining score-only targets have no matched source/evaluation row with compatible model, effort, benchmark, and usage evidence. AA suite-cost proxies are used only for their exact AA rows; Fireworks cost values are used only on their own rows. Unknown effort labels, unknown harnesses, older benchmark versions, and other model variants are not silently transferred.

coverageAudit.outcomeRule: Every listed target had null source-reported mean cost, mean output tokens, and mean time. Exact targetObservationId entries in scenarioObservationIds receive separate scenarios outside strict mode; costOnlyScenarioObservationIds have a cost scenario only and no inferred tokens or time. Approved measurement fields remain null. Chart-precedence suppression is applied before chart filters and is listed separately because suppressed reports remain in the evidence table and exports. Unknown benchmark version alone is not a conflict; this is display precedence, not a merge or equivalence claim.

sourceSearchGroups.finding: The 12 variant rows provide suite-pooled cost, time, and mixed-category tokens, without DeepSWE efficiency allocation. Seven exact AA targets have full usage scenarios; three other model targets (Fable 5.1 and DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 / V4 Flash 0731) use only their exact row's pooled suite cost as a proxy. AA Qwen3.8 Max and Kimi K3 were not given proxies because applicable Datacurve v1.1 results take chart precedence; Kimi's AA effort is unspecified.

Checked all 70 official configurations and the exact-model/effort usage rows. Direct DeepSWE references support the AA Astra max, Opus 5 max, GPT-5.6 Sol max, and GPT-5.6 Luna max scenarios; exact-model/effort pairs support the OpenAI max and Opus 5 time calibrations. Other targets have no compatible exact configuration in this feed.

Reviewed the existing primary-source captures and row-specific metric missing reasons. These sources report scores/configuration results but no aligned per-task cost, output-only usage, and comparable time tuple. Unknown effort, harness, or score protocol remains unknown.

Fireworks Cost/Task remains outside normalized mean cost because its aggregation and billing basis are unspecified and it supplies no output/time values. Its four values appear only as same-row source-reported cost scenarios without transfers. Older Datacurve paper rows are version-unknown and have no matching efficiency data; no current feed usage is joined to them.

Meta reports 75.4 on the DeepSWE v1.1 row for Muse Spark 1.3 max and defines task pass rate with the mini-swe-agent harness. Its per-model denominator, run count, uncertainty, and per-task usage are not reported; no estimate or Muse Spark 1.1/1.2 usage is transferred.

noDataReasonsByMetric.cost: No attributable DeepSWE mean cost or defensible same-model/effort transfer is available for these target observations. Fireworks' unscoped Cost/Task remains separate.
noDataReasonsByMetric.outputTokens: No output-only DeepSWE count or exact-compatible output calibration is available. Mixed Coding Agent totals are not output tokens; score and rate-card conversion are not used.
noDataReasonsByMetric.time: No compatible measured per-task wall-clock pair supports transfer for these target identities. Advertised tokens/second, agent-step counts, and total job elapsed time are not converted into task duration.
